meta.title: Outlive
meta.description: Run coding agents and shell commands outside the session in transient systemd units; results come back to the session.
meta.detail:
Background work started inside the harness dies with the dsh process. Outlive writes a script, hands it to a transient systemd unit in a different cgroup, and then only reads the log and exit marker. Restarting dsh loses the poll loop, not the work — which is why a restart makes a good Outlive job.

Six tools: outlive_run for one shell command, outlive_agent for a whole task on a coding agent, outlive_agents for agent detection and configuration, outlive_status and outlive_list for the ledger, outlive_cancel to stop a job. The side panel lists running jobs with their logs and the saved tasks. There is no restart button: restarting dsh is `outlive_run command="systemctl --user restart dsh-web"`, and because the job runs outside the process it restarts, that command survives the restart it triggers.
